#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

int solve(string s, char x) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == 'X') {
            s[i] = x;
        }
    }
    if (s[0] == '0') {
        return 0;
    }
    int ans = 1;
    bool first = true;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == '_') {
            ans *= (i == 0 ? 9 : 10);
        } else if (s[i] == 'X' && first) {
            ans *= (i == 0 ? 9 : 10);
            first = false;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

bool canReplace(const string& s, char a, char b) {
    if (s[s.length() - 2] >= '0' && s[s.length() - 2] <= '9' && s[s.length() - 2] != a) {
        return false;
    }
    if (s[s.length() - 1] >= '0' && s[s.length() - 1] <= '9' && s[s.length() - 1] != b) {
        return false;
    }
    if (s[s.length() - 2] == 'X' && s[s.length() - 1] == 'X' && a != b) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    string s;
    getline(cin, s);
    if (s.length() < 2) {
        cout << (s[0] == '0' || s[0] == '_' || s[0] == 'X' ? 1 : 0) << endl;
    } else {
        int ans = 0;
        vector<pair<char,char>> pairs = {{'0','0'}, {'2','5'}, {'5','0'}, {'7','5'}};
        for (auto& p : pairs) {
            char a = p.first;
            char b = p.second;
            if (canReplace(s, a, b)) {
                string t = s;
                t[t.length() - 2] = a;
                t[t.length() - 1] = b;
                char x;
                if (s[s.length() - 2] == 'X') {
                    x = t[t.length() - 2];
                } else if (s[s.length() - 1] == 'X') {
                    x = t[t.length() - 1];
                } else {
                    x = 'X';
                }
                ans += solve(t, x);
            }
        }
        cout << ans << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
